title: A Responsibility-Centered Coordination Mechanism for Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.21243v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Centralized orchestration provides comprehensive multi-agent coordination but creates bottlenecks in scalability, adaptability, and collective performance. Decentralized approaches alleviate these bottlenecks by distributing coordination across agents, yet often leave responsibility for delegated dependencies and failure recovery unclear. To address this gap, we propose RCM, a responsibility-centered coordination mechanism that leverages commitments to couple task delegation with explicit responsibilities of the involved parties. Through recursive delegation, agents retain their upstream responsibilities while locally orchestrating downstream commitments, thereby preserving accountability across delegation chains, creating a network of local orchestration. translated_title: 一种面向去中心化多智能体系统的以责任为中心的协调机制
translated_abstract: 集中式编排提供了全面的多智能体协调，但在可扩展性、适应性和整体性能方面造成了瓶颈。去中心化方法通过将协调分散到各个智能体中来缓解这些瓶颈，但往往使委托依赖和故障恢复的责任不明确。为了解决这一空白，我们提出了RCM——一种以责任为中心的协调机制，它利用承诺将任务委托与相关方的明确责任耦合起来。通过递归委托，智能体在保留其上游责任的同时在本地编排下游承诺，从而在委托链中保持问责性，形成一个本地编排网络。我们通过责任约束决策和面向责任的通信协议（RCP）在本地实现这一机制，使智能体能够自主……
tldr: 本文提出一种以责任为中心的协调机制RCM，通过承诺将任务委托与明确责任耦合，并借助责任约束决策和面向责任的通信协议，在去中心化多智能体系统中实现跨委托链的问责保持和本地编排网络。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RCM, a responsibility-centered coordination mechanism that couples task delegation with explicit responsibilities through commitments, using responsibility-constrained decision-making and a responsibility-oriented communication protocol to preserve accountability across delegation chains in decentralized multi-agent systems.
